title: Cutting an amethyst egg 💜🥚
description: Crystals inside an egg?! 💎 Sound on 🔊

scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. A smooth white egg made of stone sits on black velvet. A sharp knife slowly scores around the middle of the egg. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Slow gritty scraping of stone.

Vertical 9:16 video, 8 seconds. The egg opens like a geode revealing a glittering purple amethyst crystal interior, sparkling under the light as it rotates slowly. Style: macro close-up, studio lighting, pure black background, ultra realistic, 4k, slow motion, crisp detailed ASMR cutting and crackling sounds, no music, no voice. Audio: Gentle crystal chimes and a satisfying hollow click.
